scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @foreman-code/contracts --filter @foreman-code/web dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @foreman-code/contracts --filter @foreman-code/api dev
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck"
scripts.lint: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --no-bail --no-sort --if-present lint"
scripts.test: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --no-bail --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present test && node --test scripts/local-production.test.mjs"
scripts.test:files: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c 'corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && node scripts/test-files.mjs "$@"' --
